uncertaintyKind: Formal catalog uncertainty; excludes extra shape, spin and thermal-model systematics. It is not the total uncertainty of displayed physical scale.
additionalSystematics: Usui2011 section2.3 omits unquantified shape, spin and thermal-model effects. Rotation can add a few to about10% in size, especially for few detections; no invented total error bar is assigned.
diameterSemantics: Mean fitted diameter of a nonrotating sphere in the modified Standard Thermal Model. Assigning it as the volume-equivalent diameter of a separate DAMIT mesh is an explicit display-scale approximation, not a published mesh-volume calibration.
limitations: Hanuš2016 Table2 lists 46 dense lightcurves across eight apparitions and 397 sparse points. Both poles remain; model 1091 is a reproducible representative, not an observational rejection of 1092. The thermal scale is approximate. Convex inversion supplies broad outline without resolved craters, concavities, reflectance or regolith texture.
visibleDescription: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 153.72 km effective diameter (catalog ±2.88 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). Thermal size supplies a volume-scale approximation. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.
